# Shiraz Persisk Restaurant & Bar

> Persian restaurant and bar in Bergen city centre (Nygårdsgaten 60). Authentic Persian grill dishes and stews, house cocktails and a curated wine list. Table booking and takeaway.

- Address: Nygårdsgaten 60, 5008 Bergen, Norway
- Phone: +47 405 52 739
- Email: post@shirazpersisk.no
- Opening hours: Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday 15:00–21:30, Friday–Saturday 15:00–23:00. Closed Monday.
- Cuisine: Persian

## Book and order

- [Book a table](https://booking.gastroplanner.no/shiraz/t)
- [Order takeaway](https://order.gastroplanner.no/s/shirazpersiskrestaurantogbar)
- [Tripadvisor](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g190502-d27527104-Reviews-Shiraz_Persisk_Restaurant_Og_Bar-Bergen_Hordaland_Western_Norway.html)
